cases.title: creates a new customs broker with all required fields filled

steps.data: Logged in and navigated to Service Providers > Customs Brokers

steps.target: Company Name, Street Address, City, State, ZIP Code, Contact Name, Email, Telephone Number, Cell Number

steps.expected: "Customs broker created successfully." banner is shown
Searching the new company name surfaces a row with the entered name, "{city}, {state}, {country}" location, and contact name

cases.title: shows a validation error when Company Name is left blank

steps.target: all required fields except Company Name

steps.expected: "The company name field is required." validation banner is shown; nothing is created

cases.title: shows a validation error when City is left blank

steps.expected: "The city field is required." validation banner is shown; nothing is created

riskNotes: Unlike Suppliers (where a blank City 500s with a raw debug page), this field fails gracefully here — verified live before writing this test, see project_conventions.md.
